summary: With 5+ years of experience in cloud and infrastructure engineering across fintech and telecom industries, bringing hands-on background in monitoring real-time transaction systems, resolving production incidents, and supporting cloud-hosted services on Microsoft Azure. Experienced in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and container-based deployments through professional experience at AMDOCS (AT&T) and Worldline.

workExperience.company: Worldline Global Services - Card and Payments
responsibilities: Monitored real-time payment transaction flows across Bancontact, Visa and Mastercard schemes using Grafana dashboards, resolved bank and customer-reported incidents in ServiceNow (SNOW) by referencing ISO 8583 error codes and scheme manuals, reducing escalations to senior engineers for recurring transaction failures.

To maintain service availability within PCI-DSS compliance boundaries, responded to HP-Nonstop Pathway process failure alerts in PagerDuty and performed process restarts and recovery actions through the OSS environment and COBOL-based operational screens.

Participated in Azure DevOps CI/CD pipeline operations for containerized application deployments, monitoring pipeline stages, flagging failures, and coordinating with the platform team to ensure smooth releases across Dev, Test, and Production environments.

To ensure operational continuity of application services, supported Docker container health monitoring by reviewing container logs, checking runtime status, and escalating anomalies to the platform team for resolution.
Assisted in maintaining Kubernetes workload health for operational services, monitoring pod status and participating in restart and recovery procedures during service degradation incidents.

To support cloud cost efficiency, participated in Cost Resource Optimization (CRO) reviews using the Astra cloud management portal, identifying idle VMs and flagging right-sizing opportunities, contributing to an ~18% reduction in infrastructure costs.

Supported existing Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure provisioning and application deployments across Dev, Test, and Production environments, participating in deployment runs, maintaining approval gate configurations, and coordinating rollback procedures to ensure reliable releases.
Assisted in migrating 20+ application hosts to RHEL 8.8 with zero downtime, validating Docker container host compatibility and verifying Connect: Direct service continuity following each OS upgrade.

Managed and maintained Azure resources including VMs, Web Apps, and Storage Accounts through the Azure Portal, performing configuration updates, VM snapshots, and sanity checks across Dev, Test, and Production environments.
Collaborated with development teams on change requests and release planning, coordinating infrastructure changes and validating environment readiness to support smooth and timely deployments.

Monitored SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs via Azure Monitor, participated in root cause analysis for production outages, and contributed to fix documentation that supported 99.95% uptime across managed services.
Maintained health of development environments in the Azure Portal, monitoring disk space and system logs to ensure stable working environments for the engineering team.

To enable rapid incident response, monitored application uptime and performance using the Azure Monitor dashboard, identifying service interruptions, and notifying senior engineers for immediate action.
Reduced onboarding time for new team members by documenting local environment setup procedures and common troubleshooting steps, creating a reusable reference guide adopted across the team.
